QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_41

question.text: By the time a fund has fully exited all its investments:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** At full exit, RVPI reduces to zero, DPI captures all distributions, so DPI = TVPI. **The Trap:** RVPI=TVPI would mean no distributions; TVPI=0 is impossible at full exit; DPI/RVPI ≠ 1 necessarily. **Cross-Exam Context:** Directly stated in Section 6.2.1.2. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Use the 'DPI = TVPI at end' framework to reconcile final fund performance.
